svg.title: Grandchildren helping Kamala record her voice setup at home
svg.desc: Warm editorial illustration of Kamala sitting on a living room sofa in a marigold saree with teal border while her sixteen-year-old granddaughter Meera holds out a smartphone showing a pulsing red Rec indicator and audio waveform, and her ten-year-old grandson Kabir kneels beside them giving an encouraging thumbs-up.
